chunks: And Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
It is not proper for a man to sell using a measure other than the measure of the city.

key_terms.بِصَاعٍ: using a sāʿ, a known unit of measure
key_terms.صَاعِ الْمِصْرِ: the standard sāʿ of the locality or city
key_terms.لِلرَّجُلِ: for a man, meaning the seller or contracting party
key_terms.يَبِيعَ: to sell in a commercial transaction
key_terms.يَصْلُحُ: is proper or permissible in a legal and practical sense

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell goods using a measure different from the standard measure of the city?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning commercial measurement in sales. It indicates that transactions should be conducted according to the recognized local standard measure, which helps prevent unfairness and dispute in trade.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3776 - Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (as), who said:
"It is not permissible for a man to sell using a measure other than the standard measure of the city."
